data.summary_en: AdaptEvo uses CA-GRPO to balance outcome and process rewards by reference confidence; its evolution module synthesizes decision knowledge and refines evaluation rubrics from repeated failures. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, In-Period exact-label accuracy is 61.9% and binary decision accuracy 72.2%, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points.
